generated.as: CASE WHEN parent_org_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'agency'::organisation_kind END

organisation_address_length.name: organisation_address_length
organisation_address_length.value: "organisation"."address" IS NULL OR char_length("organisation"."address") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

organisation_notes_length.name: organisation_notes_length
organisation_notes_length.value: "organisation"."notes" IS NULL OR char_length("organisation"."notes") BETWEEN 1 AND 4000

invite_alias_matches_kind.name: invite_alias_matches_kind
invite_alias_matches_kind.value: ("invite"."org_kind" = 'agency' AND "invite"."alias" IS NOT NULL) OR ("invite"."org_kind" <> 'agency' AND "invite"."alias" IS NULL)

invite_not_used_and_revoked.name: invite_not_used_and_revoked
invite_not_used_and_revoked.value: NOT ("invite"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invite"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

lead_draft_complete.name: lead_draft_complete
lead_draft_complete.value: "lead"."stage" = 'draft' OR NOT "lead"."released" OR ("lead"."alias_identity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "lead"."host_member_id" IS NOT NULL)

lead_prospect_title_length.name: lead_prospect_title_length
lead_prospect_title_length.value: (NOT "lead"."released" AND "lead"."prospect_title" = '') OR (char_length(btrim("lead"."prospect_title")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND "lead"."prospect_title" = btrim("lead"."prospect_title"))

lead_prospect_company_length.name: lead_prospect_company_length
lead_prospect_company_length.value: (NOT "lead"."released" AND "lead"."prospect_company" = '') OR (char_length(btrim("lead"."prospect_company")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND "lead"."prospect_company" = btrim("lead"."prospect_company"))

lead_prospect_domain_length.name: lead_prospect_domain_length
lead_prospect_domain_length.value: (NOT "lead"."released" AND "lead"."prospect_domain" = '') OR (char_length(btrim("lead"."prospect_domain")) BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND "lead"."prospect_domain" = lower(btrim("lead"."prospect_domain")))

meeting_reschedule_resolved_check.name: meeting_reschedule_resolved_check
meeting_reschedule_resolved_check.value: ("meeting_reschedule"."status" = 'open' AND "meeting_reschedule"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "meeting_reschedule"."picked_time" IS NULL) OR ("meeting_reschedule"."status" <> 'open' AND "meeting_reschedule"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

meeting_attendee_replied_check.name: meeting_attendee_replied_check
meeting_attendee_replied_check.value: ("meeting_attendee"."reply" = 'invited' AND "meeting_attendee"."replied_at" IS NULL) OR ("meeting_attendee"."reply" <> 'invited' AND "meeting_attendee"."replied_at" IS NOT NULL)

rejection_review_resolved_check.name: rejection_review_resolved_check
rejection_review_resolved_check.value: ("rejection_review"."status" = 'open' AND "rejection_review"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("rejection_review"."status" = 'resolved' AND "rejection_review"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

client_collateral_target.name: client_collateral_target
client_collateral_target.value: ("client_collateral"."kind" = 'link' AND "client_collateral"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "client_collateral"."file_ref" IS NULL) OR ("client_collateral"."kind" = 'file' AND "client_collateral"."file_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "client_collateral"."url" IS NULL)

client_contact_email_length.name: client_contact_email_length
client_contact_email_length.value: "client_contact"."email" IS NULL OR char_length("client_contact"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254

client_contact_phone_length.name: client_contact_phone_length
client_contact_phone_length.value: "client_contact"."phone" IS NULL OR char_length("client_contact"."phone") BETWEEN 3 AND 40
